rooms.1: A green field before a fairy-tale stone castle with pointed towers, surrounded by a blue moat. The castle gate is firmly CLOSED: its wooden drawbridge is RAISED upright against the gateway, covering it, so there is no way across the moat. Leafy trees on both sides under a blue sky.
rooms.2: Standing on a wooden drawbridge, looking down at your own bare feet on the rough planks; the castle's stone wall rising on the right, wild swirls of magical wind in a deep blue sky.
rooms.3: A castle courtyard enclosed by red brick walls with arched doorways and turrets, a gleaming golden magic fountain with sculpted figures at its centre, green flagstones.
rooms.4: Close up of an ornate golden magic fountain: sculpted winged cherubs and arches in gleaming yellow gold, water splashing, red brick wall behind.
rooms.5: A stream of molten lava flowing through a dark red cavern, flames flickering on its surface, rocky banks above and below.
rooms.6: On top of a magic fountain looking down: a great burst of white and blue water spraying outward, stone gargoyle figures on either side, a dark square air shaft in the wall.
rooms.7: A grand purple ballroom: a black-and-white checkered floor, a sparkling crystal chandelier hanging near the ceiling, a balcony railing running along the right wall, a rope tied to a hook on the left wall.
rooms.8: Clinging to a huge crystal chandelier, looking down through its sparkling crystals at a black-and-white checkered ballroom floor far below.
rooms.9: A dark green enchanted forest: huge mossy tree trunks, a knot hole in the nearest tree, a twisting path, eerie green light.
rooms.10: A plain room with grey stone walls pocked with dark holes and a floor of brown tiles, bare and still.
rooms.11: A green stone storeroom: a stairway leading down at the back, a blank wooden sign nailed to the wall, a mossy wall on the right.
rooms.12: A green stone dungeon cell: a heavy red oak door shut in the left wall, a low wooden bench on the right, a square air shaft high in the far wall.
rooms.13: A grey stone anteroom: a heavy oak door with iron hinges and a ring handle, shut, in the far wall; stone steps leading up at the side.
rooms.14: A staircase of yellow-brown stone bricks descending between high walls, dead green leaves on the bottom steps.
rooms.15: A loft above a ballroom: looking down over a white balcony railing onto a black-and-white checkered floor far below, purple walls.
rooms.16: In the water of a castle moat: rippling blue water, a stone castle wall on the right, overhanging trees on the left, and a green scaly moat monster asleep half-submerged in the water.
rooms.17: Underwater in thick, murky blue fluid, cloudy and dim, nothing clear to be seen.
rooms.18: Under a wooden staircase: the undersides of the steps sloping overhead, brick walls, a little rubbish on the floor.
rooms.19: Inside a hollow tree: rough olive bark walls curving all around, a round knot hole of light, a mossy floor; carved swirling patterns in the bark (no letters).
rooms.20: A pool of dirty water spreading on a grey floor beneath white kitchen cupboards, a dripping tap above.
rooms.21: A castle kitchen: pink walls, a black iron stove, white cupboards and a sink with a tap, a large floor drain, a wooden crate on the floor.
rooms.22: Standing on top of a wooden crate, looking down at your own bare feet on its lid, a riveted grey metal wall in front.
rooms.23: Inside a wooden crate: dark olive plank walls and lid all around in perspective, a narrow gap of light.
rooms.24: A dusty room of red-brown brick and grey stone pocked with holes, a heavy stone door shut in the far wall, a tiled floor.
rooms.25: A stone staircase rising steeply between blue walls toward a dark doorway at the top, an iron handrail on the right.
rooms.26: A damp brown cavern: rough rock walls and an arched cave mouth, a glowing stream of hot lava crossing the floor.
rooms.27: A stone grotto: jagged brown rock with long white icicle-like stalactites hanging over a dark opening.
rooms.28: A castle entryway: a white stone arch in a red brick wall, through it a lowered wooden drawbridge stretching over the moat toward distant hills; a slot in the wall to the left of the arch.
rooms.29: A dragon's lair: a rounded cave of brown boulders, and an old green dragon curled on the floor, scaly and tired.
rooms.30: A wizard's workshop: stone walls, wooden shelves of jars and books, cobwebs, round holes in the walls, a cluttered floor.
rooms.31: A vacant room: bare blue walls, a brick floor, a crack in the plaster, nothing else.
rooms.32: Death: a grinning skull wearing a green pointed wizard's hat with a star, skeletal hands raised, on a dark gold background, ominous and comic.

items.4: A lowered wooden castle drawbridge seen from the front, its planks stretching across, chains at its sides.
items.26: A fallen crystal chandelier lying smashed in a heap of sparkling crystals and bent metal.
items.30: A heavy red oak door standing open on its hinges, swung back against the wall, darkness beyond its frame.
items.32: A heavy grey oak door with iron hinges standing open, a dark doorway beyond.
items.39: A murky lake bottom of dark weeds and silt, seen as a wide low strip.
items.47: A ragged hole broken through a pink plaster ceiling, seen from below, darkness beyond.
items.49: A large ragged hole broken through a plaster wall, dark red darkness beyond.
items.54: A heavy stone door swung open, showing a dark passage beyond.
items.55: A raised wooden drawbridge seen from inside: a tall arched wooden door of heavy planks closing an archway.
items.60: A ragged hole broken through a green stone wall, with darkness beyond.
items.74: An old iron lever set in a wall slot.
items.75: A pack of snarling rabid black rats with red eyes.
